Enjoy The Evergreen Kannada Classic “Theredide Mane” From The Legendary Kannada Movie Hosa Belaku, Starring Dr. Rajkumar And Saritha, With Music Composed By M. Ranga Rao.
Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema And Enjoy This Memorable Melody From One Of Kannada Film Music’s Classic Collections
Classic Kannada Melodies, Old Movie Songs, And Timeless Musical Hits.
Produced By: S. A. Srinivas, Sadanand, Rajashekar, Shivaram
Director By: Dorai–Bhagavan
Artist Name: Dr.RajKumer, Saritha
Music Director: M. Ranga Rao
Banner: Kathyayini Cine Art Combines
